label: sem-fence
verdicts: CE for scripts is a sound fencing token: checkCe runs inside the same run-lock hold as every scripted act (lib.mjs:1467) and handover raise writes coord.json in its own hold (handover.mjs:313-343). Unfenced: session tools, Read of status.json, Write under plan/, helpers; the coordinator hook takes no --ce.

M6: the READY re-check and the CAS share one lock hold (replace.mjs:454-481), but READY is written by the child's Write/Edit tool with only an unlocked guard-hook epoch check before it (guard-hook.mjs:394-409); a torn READY reads as absent (replace.mjs:194-198), so the fence proceeds.

D3: the session start is a coordinator tool call that writes nothing on disk; replace start answers repeat on an admitted row (replace.mjs:867-873); the child hook checks the epoch only, so any number of sessions pass. Today session tools are not in the coordinator profile, so no session can be started at all.

M4: no process list -> slots null -> slots-unknown -> every admission refused (replace.mjs:847-852, admit.mjs:226,470); live and unknown count alike, so the process list matters only for a fenced attempt whose transcript lags.

Commit: exclusive create by temp + hard link (lib.mjs:659-695) and row update in one lock hold (commit.mjs:808-866); no script marks a row committed from the record, so model.mjs:188 is a branch the code lacks and it masks WX.

New, verified in code (reachability inferred): a row committed at step started can never be stopped (commit.mjs:843 vs stop.mjs:278, bind refuses committed replace.mjs:987): its slot is held for ever and handover stays not-quiescent for ever.

Inferred: if claude.exe's command line does not name the folder, stop verify can confirm a fenced attempt whose transcript lags (stop.mjs:426), so a late session of e1 runs beside e2 uncounted; and an idle READY child can be confirmed stopped without a close.
abstraction: Split: child READY into hook then land (one bit rh); session-tool start then bind with SID known only within the turn; transcript visibility as an environment step (bit tv); one yield before OP.T for a stale coordinator; committed close as request, tool close, verify; old alarm survives the raise. Merge: fence check+CAS+ledger, ce check+act, start's decision+build+row, hook read+rh. Coordinator ce as current/stale. Delete model.mjs:188.

candidate_fixes.D3: fencing token checked at the resource: (a) prefixes named: coordinator hook with --ce creates start.json by exclusive create, plus (b); (b) not named: child hook claims the attempt by exclusive create of session.claim with its session id
candidate_fixes.D4a: TOCTOU on revocation: READY intent as a test-and-set under the run lock in the child's hook (ready_claim in the row) with a tick lease; Q6 (a) in lib.fence readyCheck, (b) in replace's re-check
candidate_fixes.D4b: at-most-once start: start-requested intent under the lock before the tool call, unknown until a start lease expires, then fence to a new epoch; claim file as backstop
candidate_fixes.D4c: script-driven release by lease: watcher act for committed attempts not stopped; stop request accepts committed/started; prefixes branch decides who closes
candidate_fixes.M6: move the READY source under the lock (the D4a claim); torn READY = unknown, not absent
candidate_fixes.CE: token check at every resource: coordinator hook with --ce denies all but reading status when stale; session tools depend on the prefixes question
candidate_fixes.RC: positive synchronous evidence (start intent, claim file) instead of absence of a transcript; keep unknown as an outcome

open_or_blocked: Whether the harness Write tool replaces a file atomically, and whether PreToolUse input carries session_id (both unverified).
Whether claude.exe's command line names the attempt folder or session id (HARNESS-FACTS 10).
Ledger line written after the row in fence, admit and bind: a death between them leaves no line (not in my scope).
Lock holder liveness unknown while PowerShell fails: a dead holder's lock is never broken, every script exits 75 (relevant to D1).
